name: Surya Sen
role: Revolutionary organizer of the Chittagong uprising
contribution: He led the Chittagong revolutionary network and organized the 1930 armoury raid against British colonial authority.
context: He emerged from anti-partition and Jugantar-era radical politics in eastern Bengal.
impact: His leadership became a lasting symbol of armed anti-colonial resistance in Bengal memory.
highlight: Masterda linked revolutionary discipline with anti-colonial action.
seoTitle: Surya Sen: Chittagong Armoury Raid and Revolution
seoDescription: Explore Surya Sen's leadership of the Chittagong revolutionary network and the 1930 armoury raid.
shortAnswer: Surya Sen, known as Masterda, organized the Chittagong revolutionary network and led the 1930 armoury raid.
